# Local MFA QR encoder

Unmodified `qrcode.js` from npm `qrcode-generator@1.4.4`, by Kazuhiko Arase (MIT). Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator.

SHA-256: `18ae399f81182bc9de916e9c77b195df20cc58d6f2d55a62b085a299f1bf1780`.

This browser-only encoder draws the local enrollment URI to a canvas. It makes no network requests and never sends the secret to a QR image service. Preserve the upstream header and accompanying license when updating it.
